question: Can a clean 2025 forecast-mode test of calendar vs gdd be run from local data?
answer: No. Stopped before any download (as instructed).

local_crop_labels.note: Scoring is conditional on the observed crop label of the scored season, so a 2025 test also needs a 2025 field crop label. No 2025 label source has been checked; whether a 2025 CSB release exists is UNVERIFIED.

download_estimate_hls_2025.method: Same route as T1.5: 3 AppEEARS point tasks (<= 1,000 points each, 2,325 points) for one calendar year. Estimate by analogy with the bundles already on disk for full years.
download_estimate_hls_2025.estimate_mb: about 175-185 MB (tag A, analogy; exact size only from the AppEEARS bundle listing after processing)
download_estimate_hls_2025.time: AppEEARS processing time per point task was not recorded in DECISIONS.md for T1.5; the T0.3 area test task took about 22.5 min. Total time is therefore UNVERIFIED (queue-dependent).
download_estimate_hls_2025.credentials: Needs an Earthdata login through _netrc (CLAUDE.md rule 12 exception).

not_needed: NASA POWER 2025 weather is not used by forecast mode (it draws past years <= 2021).
